trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself. Work through the roadmap in order — story, partner and stranger missions, collectibles, activities and the two missable moments — and close with the 100% completion trophy.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so just play the intro through to the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Keep playing the story missions in order; the trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Story only — follow the mission markers until the chapter ends.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Story only; the chapter-complete screen is the trigger.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Story only — finish the chapter's final mission.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. This is the story finale, so it comes last in the story path; finish it and the gold pops.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Follow the story order; the mission unlocks as the plot reaches it.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story heist — play it when the plot offers it.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story only; it appears in the mission flow.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story only; follow the mission markers.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission at the airport; finish it to pop the trophy.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story only; the last big story mission before the finale stretch.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. This is the long grind: finish every story mission, stranger strand, collectible set, activity and challenge the game counts. Check the in-game stats page to see what is left, and save it for last — it is the final step before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near-misses and airtime; chain them while driving around Leonida and the counter climbs. Free-roam driving between missions is the fastest way to stack them.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are 9 activity types in the game — play one session of each (races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, bowling, drone races and the rest) and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 challenges across the ranges; learn each weapon's pattern, take your time on the timed lanes, and replay any challenge until it shows gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 drone race locations; win one race at each. Use the boost gates and cut the corners — a win at every site is what counts, not a perfect run.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter races across Leonida — street, off-road and water — and win 20 distinct ones. Replaying the same race does not count twice.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, learn the reeling rhythm, and out-fish him. It is a single head-to-head, so a loss just means trying again.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk into any arcade, start a cabinet game and play it to its end screen.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Follow Andy's mission strand to its last mission and finish it.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's strand to its final mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's strand to its final mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Strangers appear as markers on the map; finish 8 full strands. Start them early — they unlock as you explore, and the counter tracks strands, not single missions.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots; sit at each one until the session completes. The map marks them once discovered — sweep the state after the story opens the map.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunting job, track the unique animal he names, and bring it down. Use a scoped weapon and approach from downwind.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; collect full sets of 3. Check shops and hidden spots — a set completes when its last card is picked up.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Find the WAiNK photo spots and snap 100 of them. They are spread across all of Leonida, so treat it as a long sweep, not a single trip.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives; finish any 50. They accumulate across activities, so just play widely and the counter climbs.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob a shop, keep the wanted level, and hit two more shops in a row with your partner beside you. Do not let the stars drop between robberies.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter 100 different vehicles; each new one you sit in counts. Car meets, parking lots and traffic are all fair game.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus with at least 5 enemies in front of you and drop all 5 before it ends. Pick a busy firefight and aim for clustered targets.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. This is a one-time story moment at the airport: when the VCIA sequence offers the unscheduled departure, take it. If you play the sequence the scheduled way, the moment is gone, so do it the first time the mission reaches the airport.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhino tanks — take them on in the mission or encounter where they appear. Heavy weapons and cover are the way through.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, enter quietly, avoid the cameras and guards, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If spotted, leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit 5 bank vaults and get away clean each time. Plan the escape route before you go in — the getaway is half the job.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck on the road, crack it open, and lose the wanted level after.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit all 52 areas of the state; the map fills in as you go. Drive every road and the trophy pops when the last area registers.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs; rob one illegal operation from each of them. The map marks gang operations once you are close.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. It is a quiet moment — no combat needed.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. This is a one-time set-piece in a showroom: when the scene puts you in the showroom, drive straight out through the glass instead of walking out. If you leave quietly, the moment is gone.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a full game.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This pops from a partnership moment that draws a crowd — play the partner content until the mass-appeal scene triggers.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. The game tracks your choices; make 500 of them across missions and activities and the trophy pops. Just keep playing — choices accumulate naturally.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something once, then succeed on the second try. A retry that lands is all it takes.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange in Leonida. Strange events hide in odd corners of the map — explore the weird spots and the trophy pops when one finds you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Score a knockdown with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Line up a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and the trophy pops on the hit.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through your contacts until the total hits $250,000. Keep the bills moving — the counter tracks laundered value, not cash held.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, weapons and gear until your lifetime shop spending passes $100,000. It counts across every shop in the game.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy all 8 garage properties around Leonida. They are the long-term money sink — save up and buy them as they appear on the market.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone, register 10 different vehicles, and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: On the Spot
